title: Home page motion, built — try it at full size

steps.path: Home > tabs, cards, the device pop-up, Edit
steps.headline: Does the built motion feel polished without getting in your way? Use the switch to compare.
steps.notice: Press: 1) Lights, Media, Home, the gear. 2) In Destin's Room, the Lights arrow, Scenes, the TV's Remote, a speaker's Group. 3) Press and hold a card (or right-click), then close with X, Escape, or outside. 4) Edit, then a device's name. 'Built, slow' shows each step at quarter speed; 'Before' has no new motion.
steps.risk: Everything that was instant now takes about a quarter of a second to settle. Nothing moves when the page refreshes by itself, and it all stays still if the computer is set to reduce motion.

variants.label: Built
variants.summary: The motion you chose, at normal speed: pages slide in, the pop-up grows from its card, contents drop in and cards below glide.
variants.risk: The pop-up's text appears a moment after its frame, so for a split second you see an empty glass panel.

variants.label: Built, slow
variants.summary: The same motion at a quarter of the speed, to see exactly what each part is doing. Not how fast it will really be.
variants.risk: Looks sluggish on purpose; judge the shape of the movement, not the speed.

variants.label: Before
variants.summary: The page with the new motion switched off, as it was: everything changes instantly.
variants.risk: Shows only the old instant behaviour, so you can feel what the motion adds or costs.
